segments.text: A former Suima noble turned into a human by angelic technology. He retains some of his former powers, but his new human frame is largely incompatible with his previous form which is a frequent source of frustration for him. When he does activate his powers, his right eye turns red.
He reacts to news of the Demon King's unexpected death as an opportunity to start his quest for revenge against the Angels who transformed him and to stake his claim as the new Demon King.

Many of his foes underestimate him because of his outward human appearance, however the magical energy he emanates is no different from other demons. He is unable to hold on to the element of surprise for long, but he's well aware that his frailties as a human force him to rely heavily on Helmina to seduce more opponents to his will.

He is well-versed in the sex magic which all Suima are inherently gifted in, so any female units taken prisoner can be bent to his will when he rapes them. The only exceptions are other Suima are Helmina and Elvire.

Although he ultimately finds and defeats the one responsible for his transformation, he cannot reverse the process as he lacks the necessary catalyst and information on the internal workings of the device that changed him. Nevertheless his ambition does not end as he turns his attention towards the other competitors for the Demon throne.
この地方の天使が持つされる技術により人間の身体にされた貴族睡魔。
元が睡魔であるが故、その力や魔力は維持しているが、人間の身体ではそれを上手く扱えない。本来使用できる魔術の数々は肉体との適合性があまり良くなく、使えるものも限られてはいるが、それらを発動すると睡魔の力に反応して片方の眼の色が変わる。身体能力は元の人間の能力でしかなく、思い通りに動けないというジレンマを持っている。
この身体となったことで他の仲間たちからは魔族の恥と虐げられているが、この地で活動をしていた魔族ではないヘルミィナからは好かれており、行動を共にしている。
常に余裕を持ち冷静さを保っているが、天使と対した際には身体への恨みから感情を全面に出す。勝気な性格からいくら敗戦の色が濃くなろうとも、上からの発言を止めることはない。
種族:元貴族睡魔
武器:短剣
戦術:指揮官能力による味方支援、及び高い技量による必中攻撃

A female Suima who calls Klaus "Darling" and stays by his side because she's taken a fancy to him and wants to see what he looked like before he was transformed (she's quite happy with Klaus's human appearance).

Early on, Klaus has to rely on her to increase the size of his army as he is unable to fully utilise his Suima powers. Helmina in turn is happy to help Klaus in his quest; she's typical of most Suima and is happy to seduce anyone and anything in return for draining their energy during sex. In addition to her fighting abilities, she has command over a flying familiar which she sometimes deploys to gather information.

Elvire hints at Helmina's background when they meet each other but it is not explained in great detail. Helmina is not originally from the mountain range where Klaus and Elvire are active, so she has no prejudice against Klaus for his predicament.
Bright and vivacious, she always has a reply up her sleeve no matter who she talks to.
クラウスをダーリンと呼び付き従う女睡魔。
大人の仕草とその妖艶な表情で数々の男を手玉に取ってきたが、面食いであるが故に精気だけ奪ってそれらの男を捨ててきたという生き様を送ってきた。
元々はこの地に侵攻してきた魔族の勢力ではなく、本人曰く与えられた生き方が性に合わなかったからと故郷を離れはぐれ化したとのこと。一部の魔族からは高貴な血筋の系列であるという噂もあるが、それが本当であるかは定かではない。
本人の気質が気分屋で楽観的であり、偶然にもクラウスを見つけ、また元々魔族であった彼の本来の姿を一目見ようと付いて行くことになる。人間になった魔族とつるんでいる変な奴と言われているが、他の魔族には興味がないようで全く気にしている様子がない。
種族:睡魔
武器:鈎爪
戦術:敏捷を生かした攻撃、並びに敵を捕獲することが出来る魅了魔術

An eighth-rank Angel who serves at the vanguard of the Angelic forces. Like all Angels, she despises Demons who bring chaos to the world and will annihilate any demons she faces without hesitation.

She is initially fooled by Klaus's appearance and assumes Klaus is a thrall under Helmina's control. Despite Helmina's repeated attempts to dissuade her, she does not listen. Klaus uses this to his advantage in their first battle.
If she is captured in battle, Klaus uses sex magic to bind her under his control. Her devotion to duty is twisted from its original purpose and redirected towards serving Klaus.
If she is present in the final battle, she will ask if the God the angels served really intended for the mass production to take place.
侵攻勢力を迎撃するべく、最前線を守護する第八位天使。
正義感が強く、世の秩序を乱す悪を相手にする際には一切の容赦はしない。しかし、その正義感の強さが故に、彼女の率いる部隊は規律が厳しく窮屈な思いをしている部下がいるというのもまた事実である。それは彼女自身が部下たちを守りたいという意志の裏返しとなっている。
自身が束ねる隊の部隊長ではあるが、後方で待機し指示を出しながら戦局を見守るのではなく、自らが常に最前線に身を置き行動をする。その為、部隊の士気は常に高い状態を保っているが、指揮官が危険にさらされやすいという欠点を持っているともいえる。
神聖魔術の行使よりも得物である槍を用いた近接戦闘を得意としており、広く大天使という階級の中でも斥候型に近い能力を持っている。
種族:第八位天使
武器:槍
戦術:攻守に優れた能力に於ける近接戦闘

A seventh-rank angel in charge of the altar of reincarnation. She's not designated a combat role and her research minimises the frequency of interpersonal contact. Eventually her desire for research leads her to pursue that course above everything else, she will even perform actions which are completely anathema to other angels.

Klaus uses vague memories of his experimentation as a guide to lead him to the site of the altar of reincarnation. After fighting in, Reginia tells them they are wasting her valuable research time as the altar cannot be used by non-angelic beings. Klaus in turn invites Reginia to join their cause, as he has observed Reginia's long hours of solitary research have warped her mindset and she is well on the way to becoming a fallen angel. Despite the temptation, Reginia is still able to refuse and they fight for control over the site.

If captured in battle, Klaus removes the shackles off Reginia's desire for research. Virtually everything for her while serving under Klaus's army is a new experience, which she savours and is happy to serve him in return. Her mindset approaches that of a typical "mad scientist" while under Klaus's control, so much so he has to rein her in before her tendencies lead to mortal casualties amongst his forces.
If present in the battle, she asks the supreme commander for permission to study the Altar but is refused.
この地の天使が保有している特殊な技法を執り行う為に使用する廻天の聖壇を管理している第七位天使。
管理者という立場から戦闘を任せられることはほぼなく、他の天使との交流をあまり持っていない。結果的に引き籠ることが多くなり研究に没頭する毎日が続いたことで、いつしか自己満足の為の研究と置き換わっていった。その為、他者からは異端の研究者と呼ばれるようになり、研究第一主義となる。
元々この技法は同種族の力を高める為のものであるが、思い付きの行動によりねじ曲がった手法を取るなど奇行に走ることさえある。その天使としてのあるべき姿から逸脱した行為により、本来純白である筈の羽根の色がくすんでいる。
種族:第七位天使
武器:杖
戦術:魔術特化による攻撃能力や支援能力

A sixth-rank Angel who is skilled both in fighting and in battlefield tactics. She prepares meticulously before a conflict to maximise the chances of victory. Helmina calls her 能面天使 for her poker face as well as a nod to her angelic title. Despite her adaptability to the flow of battle, she can get flustered if events progress beyond her calculations.

She is ordered to capture Klaus and retake the altar of reincarnation shortly after Klaus and Helmina defeat Reginia. With great difficulty, Klaus and Reginia succeed in breaking out of the encirclement. When she returns to her base to think through her next move, Elvire attacks with her forces. When Klaus and Helmina attack shortly after Elvire's assault, Luciel is unable to overcome the disparate demonic factions attacking at once.

If captured in battle, Klaus uses the threat of sex magic to coerce her into having sex with him. She is fully aware of what that magic is and never expected Klaus to be an expert at it based on his outward appearance. In the end, Klaus does not need to use the magic to bind her to his will, as he correctly guesses her fixation on battlefield preparation and emphasis on tactics are really her way of coping with a streak of cowardice.
If present in the final battle, Luciel reveals the importance she places on her sense of self-identity and why she remains compelled to serve Klaus even though she is not magically bound to his will.
知と力を併せ持つ戦闘型の第六位天使。
階級に見合う戦闘能力を持つが、それ以上の智謀により状況に合った戦術を導き出して戦場を駆ける頭脳派。保有している部隊が強力なこともあり、戦術の効果も相まって高い戦果を上げている。
戦闘における敗北をしない為の準備は怠らず、戦況が不利とみれば即座に引き上げるといった判断や他部隊への応援要請などの判断に関しても柔軟である。これらの行為は、彼女自身が敗北や死に対して大きな恐怖感を抱いており、現実として起きないように予防線を引いているに過ぎない。
常に戦況を計算し行動、相手にも思い通りになるように仕向けるが、思い通りに行くことが当たり前の戦場を駆けてきた為に、大きな戦局変化には考えが追い付かなくなり動揺を隠しきれない面がある。
種族:第六位天使
武器:剣
戦術:戦術眼に秀で、術技を柔軟に使いこなす万能型

The field commander of the Angelic Forces defending against the demonic incursion. A fifth-rank Angel who rarely strays from the mountain where the Angelic stronghold is located. She has combat abilities commensurate with her angelic rank and is a capable strategist with a cold and calm demeanour. Simply approaching Klaus and his party gives off an aura of power which brings a cold sweat from both demons.
Mavislaine knows all of the other ranked Angels by name, so if they are present when Klaus and his faction do battle with her she will admonish them for joining his ranks.

As the field commander, she is closest to the supreme commander of the Angelic Forces and one of her duties is to ensure no demon gets close to her superior. Klaus and Helmina comment on the mountain being known only to a select few demons (Beatrice being one of them), which implies Mavislaine and her subordinates have until now done an excellent job at ensuring virtually all intruders into the mountain do not leave alive.

If captured in battle, she does fully submit to Klaus's will. He in turn does not use sex magic on her even though he is perfectly capable of doing so. Klaus derives considerable satisfaction from watching Mavislaine squirm as she chafes under his command; he believes breaking a woman with strong will like her under his will without magical means is more challenging with a greater payoff should he succeed.
この地に存在する数ある天使の軍団を統率する指揮官の立場である第五位天使。
階級に違わぬ能力を持ち合わせているのは勿論ではあるが、それ以上に他者を引き付ける気質と容姿を持ち、信頼のおける存在として認められ指揮を執っている。常に冷静沈着で近寄りがたい雰囲気を出しているが、その冷静さが勝利をもたらす要因である。
天使を個々の存在として認識しており気配り上手である反面、見ず知らずの者と接することになれておらず、親しい関係以外の者との会話を苦手をしているという一面を持つ。
この地に於ける天使の拠点に身を置き、侵略者の監視や迎撃を行い守護するという任務に尽力している。
種族:第五位天使
武器:槍
戦術:高い戦闘指揮、及び支援効果に優れた術技

A Suima Princess who avoids armed conflict. She much prefers to use her childlike appearance to seduce males for their sperm. Although proud of her bloodline and her wings, she is easily displeased when Klaus and Helmina (who are technically her subjects) don't treat her with the respect she believes she is owed.

Klaus initially seeks his fellow Suima, both to increase the number of pawns he can control and to lessen the burden on Helmina for new recruits. Helmina's extraordinary ability to detect her own kind leads to an encounter with Cerouge.

Despite her distaste for war and fighting, Cerouge is surprisingly capable as a strategic commander. Klaus is appreciative of her choice of hideout and the efforts she and her subordinates took to deter rogue Angel patrols from disturbing their peace.

If captured in battle, she initially attempts to turn the tables on Klaus using sex magic. However, she never discovers Klaus's true identity until it is too late. Klaus acknowledges her bloodline, but she can never overturn his authority because of his experience and abilities.
戦闘行為を好まない睡魔。
王女に成る血筋ではあるが、子供っぽく悪戯好きであり楽しそうなことには何でも興味を持つ。自身の容姿で男の気を引けることを自覚しており、精気が必要な際にはその容姿を利用し相手を騙すことで得ている。また、ずる賢い為、常に自身より強い格上には見つからないように隠密行動を取り、相手にするのはあくまで格下のみである。
日常から戦闘行為を避けて生活をしている為、王女の血筋に比した高い魔術能力を持っているが、そのことを自覚してはいない。
普段は他者に見つからないよう隠れて過ごしている事の方が多いが、統率が取れなくなっている魔王軍を見て精気を得る機会が増えたとばかりに行動を起こす度合いが増加傾向にある。
種族:睡魔
武器:鈎爪
戦術:高い魔術能力、並びに敵を捕獲することが出来る魅了魔術

A Waima initially encountered by Klaus and Helmina when she's on the run from a group of Angels pursuing her for the theft of a valuable coin in the Angels' possession. When Maize asks for help but is refused, she draws the attention of her angelic pursuers to Klaus and his group, which forces them into combat.

Maize loves gold, in particular the hard currency used by the humans. She stashes her collection amidst ruins and spends her days either admiring her stash or going out to look for more additions to her collection. She values gold and currency above everything else, even her own life and freedom.

Given a choice between giving gold as a reward to Klaus and his group for saving her bacon and simply running away with just a word of thanks, she chooses the latter. This enrages Klaus and they track her to her hideout where she is forced to defend herself from intruders to her "home".

If captured in battle, Klaus confiscates her entire stash and uses it to bribe Maize into fighting for him (in addition to the use of sex magic). Because of her typical Waima personality, Klaus avoids talking to her for any longer than he has to because it is a mentally draining experience.
物品への好奇心が高く収集欲が旺盛な歪魔。
金品や武具の収集を中心として行っているが、現在は特に人間が使用している通貨に注目をしており重点的に収集を行っている。大きさや材質、意匠の機微に着目をしており、いつしか人間にも劣らない半ば鑑定士のような目利きを身に付けている。
人懐っこくはあるが常に高い高揚感に包まれており、誰からも付き合い辛いと言われ群れることがない。いつしか人間の行き来が盛んな交易路へ棲み処を移して様々な通貨の収集を夢見ているが、共に行動する仲間がおらず距離も遠いことから断念している。
種族:歪魔
武器:短剣
戦術:高い敏捷・技量を生かした白兵戦

A Suima noble who knows Klaus and Helmina. She derives personal satisfaction from the thrill of battle and spends all of her time training for battle if she's not involved in one. Her lust for battle is so strong she will happily fight her own kind if there is no suitable opposition around and she's in the mood for combat.

She knew Klaus and Helmina well before the story starts and is well aware of Klaus's current state. Both of them in turn are fully aware she's obsessed with fighting and prefer to be as far away as possible from her since Elvire is almost impossible to stop when the mood takes her. Interestingly enough, neither Klaus nor Helmina knew they had a mutual acquaintance in Elvire until they encountered her.
Her insatiable lust for battle put her at odds with Klaus, yet she rates his ability to think his way through any battle despite his current frailty highly.

If captured in battle, she will help Klaus in his quest as one of his soldiers. As a Suima noble herself, the only thing that keeps her under Klaus's command is losing to him in battle and the interesting battles she will enjoy while serving under him.
クラウスとは旧知の仲である貴族悪魔。
戦うことに己の満足感を見出しており、またその戦いに勝利する為の鍛錬を生きがいとして日々を送る。その為、戦闘行為そのものに関心を持っており、その行為には意味や理由を持つことはない。
自己の満足の為であれば戦う相手は敵味方を問わず、時として戦場を荒らしてしまうのが玉に瑕。それ故に自身よりも力ある者に対しては種族に関係なく、その力を認め敬意を払い付き従うことも辞さない。
クラウスとは基本的に反りの合わないことが多いが、例え人間の身体になっても陰ることのない支配する力に於いては認めている節がある。
種族:貴族悪魔
武器:斧
戦術:自己の力を高め、類い稀な力によって繰り出される近接攻撃
クラウスとは旧知の仲である貴族睡魔。
戦うことに己の満足感を見出しており、
またその戦いに勝利する為の鍛錬を生きがいとして日々を送る。
その為、戦闘行為そのものに関心を持っており、
その行為には意味や理由を持つことはない。
自己の満足の為であれば戦う相手は敵味方を問わず、
時として戦場を荒らしてしまうのが玉に瑕。
それ故に自身よりも力ある者に対しては種族に関係なく、
その力を認め敬意を払い付き従うことも辞さない。
クラウスと反りの合わないことが多いが、
人間の身体になっても陰ることのない支配する力に於いては認めている節がある。

A Hitenma who deserted the Demon King's command and is now holed up in a remote corner of the Imniss mountain range. Younger than the rest of her peers, she has not adopted her kind's single-minded approach to battle. When the conflict between the Angels and Demons reached an impasse, she struggled to find meaning in an endless series of skirmishes and took off with several of her followers. She spends her days contemplating the meaning of her existence, watching over the conflict from a distance and defending her territory from intruders.

Klaus seeks her out as he requires information on the whereabouts of the Angels' stronghold, which Beatrice can provide as she was at the forefront of battle before she deserted. Although she acknowledges the futility of the endless struggle between the two sides, she still holds pride as a Hitenma, one of the strongest of the warrior Demon tribes and does not hesitate to cut down any who intrude into her territory.

If she is captured by Klaus and submits to his authority, she continues to agonise over her purpose in a war she does not believe in. Klaus in turn enjoys watching her internal angst with the occasional word of advice to keep her focused on the immediate goal, even as he acknowledges her immense value as one of his prime military assets.
魔族の王の戦い方に共感できなくなり、袂を別った飛天魔。
常日ごろから自身がこの場にいる意義を持たせており、敵と戦うにせよ味方を護るにせよ、その意義に基づいている。以前より戦況が硬直し何一つ進展しない戦いに自信の存在意義を見出せなくなり、王の下を離れることとなった。
軍を抜ける際には一部の魔族が自信を慕って共に離脱をしているが、戦闘は身に降りかかる火の粉を払うのみに留めており、己の存在意義を今一度見つめなおすべく静観をしている。
飛天魔という特性上、単独で上位天使と戦い打ち勝つことが出来る能力を持っており、その戦闘能力はこの地に集結している魔族の中でも上位に位置する。その為、以前からの単独行動の所為あって集団でいることをあまり好まない。

A mascot character.

The supreme commander of the Angelic Forces and the one responsible for cloning the ranked Angels after their death or subversion at Klaus's hand. Her manner of speech resembles that of a robot, and her train of thought takes logic to its extreme. She recognises Klaus as one of the "test subjects" and attempts to reclaim him when he and his forces invade the Altar.
She recognises all of the ranked Angels by name and will engage them briefly in conversation if they are present in the final battle and are engaged in combat.

When defeated, Klaus surmises that the order to clone the Angels wasn't strictly given at the behest of the God the Angels serve, instead Olga had some ulterior motive for taking action which is not fully explained.
